scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@inova/domain && npm run dev --workspace=@inova/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@inova/domain && npm run dev --workspace=@inova/api
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@inova/domain && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace=@inova/domain && tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters -p back/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters -p front/tsconfig.json
